summary: Volkswagen Auto Lease/Loan Underwritten Funding, LLC filed a routine Form 8-K with items 1.01 and 9.01 on September 23, 2026, reporting the closing of an auto-lease ABS issuance. Volkswagen Auto Lease Trust 2026-B issued Class A-1 through A-4 asset-backed notes with an aggregate initial principal amount of $991,830,000 on September 22, 2026, per the Final Prospectus dated September 15, 2026. The filing attaches transaction documents, including the SUBI Supplement and transfer agreements. No special-situation event—no equity stake, per-share price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, regulatory clock, or deal termination—is present; this is an ordinary structured-finance shelf takedown.
